text:
alex: Heads-up — seeing a perf regression on mixed-quant prefill for long-context workloads after the recent kernel-selection tweak. TTFT ~28% worse on INT8-prefill paths. Anyone else?

maria: yup, noticed on staging. Profiler shows kernel flapping between fp8_prefill_kernel and int8_prefill_kernel across layers 4-18. Calibration deltas oscillating.

cheng: KV cache eviction spikes when microbatch size dips below 4 — that increases prefill work and pushes TTFT up. Scheduler is chopping requests too eagerly.

sam: quick bench numbers: prefill TTFT: baseline 310ms -> 400ms (8k context, batched), decode TPS roughly same. We should avoid frequent kernel switches during prefill.

maria: logs: 
```
[profiler] layer=6 choose_kernel=int8_prefill_kernel calib_delta=0.015
[profiler] layer=6 choose_kernel=fp8_prefill_kernel calib_delta=0.021
[profiler] layer=6 choose_kernel=int8_prefill_kernel calib_delta=0.017
```
this flipping lines up with the TTFT spikes.

lee: proposal: add selector hysteresis (require N consecutive samples to flip) + smooth calibration value with EWMA. Also prefer stable kernel for prefill path (even if slightly suboptimal throughput) to keep TTFT consistent. :+1:

infra-bot: deploy triggered: kernel-selector-hysteresis v2003 -> staging

maria: post-deploy quick numbers: TTFT improved to ~330ms (was 400), but longctx=8k still ~15% above baseline. KV eviction still present on some tails.

sam: plan: 1) land hysteresis + EWMA smoothing (PR #2912), 2) bump microbatch target to 6 for longctx workloads to reduce eviction, 3) add explicit prefill_kernel_preference flag per model. I'll own the PRs and perf runs.

alex: sgtm — tagging @lee for oncall monitoring and @maria for perf dashboards. Links: https://dash.redwood/prefill-longctx / perf run: https://ci.redwood/runs/4589

lee: I'll watch error budgets and TTFT SLOs overnight. If we still see >10% regression we'll revert selector tweak.

sam: adding a small profiler heatmap to the PR showing per-layer kernel choice distribution and KV eviction rate. Will post bench results here when done.
